description: Unbeatable Bang For Your Buck Hydraulic brakes are a must have, the Rockshox BLUTO is worth approx $699 alone. Ringle MuleFut Rim Wheels are Tubeless Compatible* Disc Wheelset (worth $700+) That's approx $1400 in parts not counting the Motobecane Carbon FatBikes Frame (Worth $1500 alone) + Maxxis Tires (~$180/pair) or the top-quality SHIMANO 1X12 Drivetrain. LIGHT WEIGHT SUB 35 LBS* This bike is lighter than most any other Fat bike in its price range AND has much higher level parts. You'll spend more than double this exclusive promo sale price to get a slightly lighter fatbike or with marginally nicer parts. *est per mfg, sml w/o pedals/reflectors/config tubeless (see tubeless info in FAQ) SWEET HANDLING Motobecane has engineered in a top Podium placing geometry into this phenomenal carbon FatBikes ride. The handling is very responsive and yet stable. You'll absolutely crush everyone else on this ride. WORLD CLASS CARBON ENGINEERING Motobecane has access to factories with some of the longest track records of carbon engineering in the bicycle industry. These factories have used their decades of engineering experience to optimize these top of the line carbon fiber FatBikes to have the ultimate high performance, power/strength to weight ratios.
